interface.longDescription: Installs the complete second-brain v3 project memory system: shared Claude and Codex routing, capability specifications, typed durable memory, natural stopping-point reviews, owner-approved librarian maintenance, and a pre-merge semantic check for parallel memory changes. Markdown and Git remain authoritative, with no database, embeddings, or background curation, and no hook that writes memory.
